description: Mark one notice as 'read' (default — same as dismissing it in the dashboard) or 'completed'. Use 'completed' ONLY when the user explicitly asks for it: in the dashboard it means the user did what the notice asked, and it is final (a completed notice never changes again). Nothing is deleted. Only the account owner and admins can mark notices. Get the id from panda_list_notices.

status.description: 'read' (default) or 'completed' (final; only if the user asks)
